project.name: Brix Runtime SDK API
project.description:
Runtime Shell Capability Contract Interface Definitions and Development Support
This module defines all contract interfaces between modules and the Runtime Shell, including: - v3.0.10 plugin SPI contracts (BrixPlugin, PluginContext, PluginBootstrapContext) - Core capability interfaces (EventBus, StateStore, AuthContext, etc.) - Event base classes (DomainEvent, IntegrationEvent) - Legacy runtime context compatibility API (RuntimeContext) - Host abstract interface - Module annotations (@Module, @EventHandler) - Legacy convenience wrappers (AbstractModule, ModuleState)
[Design Principles] - This module is the contract definition layer; it contains no infrastructure implementations - Modules (Plugins) only need to depend on this module - BrixPlugin and PluginContext are the v3.0.10 plugin entry contracts - YAML plugin-manifest.yaml remains the declarative source of truth; Java SPI does not expose manifest() - RuntimeContext, AbstractModule, and LifecycleCapability are v3.0.9 compatibility APIs under the v3.0.10 Runtime Shell baseline - Importing Kafka/Redis/MySQL or other infrastructure dependencies is prohibited
